senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (शक्यति-ते) r. 5th cl. (इर ऌ) इरशक्तृ (शक्नोति)
1 To bear patiently, to endure, to be patient.
2 To be able to effect, to be competent or powerful.
(इ) शकि r. 1st cl. (शङ्कते)
1 To think probable, to suspect.
2 To fear, to apprehend.
With आङ्,
to dread.

m. (-कः)
1 A sovereign, any prince who gives his name to an era, especially applied to Śālivāhana.
2 A particular caste, the followers or descendants of ŚAKA, or Sālivāhana.
3 A country, or
m. plu. (-काः)
The inhabitants, the Sacœ, the Scythians.
4 An era: see शाक.
E.
शक to be able, aff. अच्.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A potherb in general, any leaf, flower, fruit, stalk, root, &c. used as a vegetable.
m. (-कः)
1 One of the seven Dvīpas or divisions of the world; the sixth, surrounded by the sea of milk or white sea.
2 Power, strength.
3 The Sirisha tree, (Acacia sirisa.)
4 The Teak tree, (Tectona grandis.)
5 An era, a period usually commencing with some celebrated prince, as YUDHIṢṬHIRA, VIKRAMĀDITYA, ŚĀLIVĀHANA, &c. thence denominated ŚĀKEŚVARAS, &c.; the term in ordinary use is applied especially to the era of ŚĀLIVĀHANA, commencing 76 or 78 years after the Christian era.
E.
शक to be able, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
He, that man.
E.
स he, कन् added.

mfn. subst. (-टः-टी-टं)
A cart.
m. (-टः)
1 A Daitya slain by KṚṢṆA.
2 A cart load.
E.
शक to be able, अटन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
Relating to a cart, (a cart-load, a carthorse, &c.)
m. (-टः)
A draught ox.
E.
शकट a cart, अण् aff.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Bad, vile.
m. (-टः)
A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)
E.
स with, कट bad.

m. (-लः)
A gallinule.

m. (-हा)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
शकट the demon so named, and हन destroyer; also similar compounds, as शकटारि, &c.

m. (-लः)
The minister of NANDA: also read ŚAKATĀRA.

f. (-ह्वा)
The fourth lunar asterism, Rohiṇī, the stars of which are represented as a cart.
E.
शकट a cart, आह्व appellation.

f. (-का)
A small cart, a toy-cart.
E.
कन् added to शकटी.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Going in or on a cart.
E.
शकट a cart, and ठक् aff.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A part, a portion, a piece.
n. (-लं)
1 Skin.
2 Bark.
3 A kind of (black) pigment or die.
4 The scales of a fish.
E.
शक to be able, कलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
All, whole, entire.
E.
स with, कला a part, अच् aff.

n. adv. (-लं)
Betimes, early in the morning.
E.
स with, काल time.

m. (-ली)
A fish.
E.
शकल skin or scales, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Parting, dividing, cutting or breaking in pieces.
E.
शकल, and करण making, with च्चि. augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Parted, cut in pieces, wounded.
E.
शकल, कृत made, augment च्चि.

m. (-वः)
A goose.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Rustling, making a noise (as the leaves of a tree in the wind.)
E.
शकत् imitative sound, nominal verb, शतृ aff.

m. (-कः)
1 The prince, VIKRAMĀDITYA.
2 The name of SĀLIVĀHANA.
E.
शक an era or a Scythian, and अन्तक destroyer.

n. (-ब्दं)
1 A year of the Śaka era, or era of SĀLIVĀHANA.
E.
शक, and अब्द a year.

m. (-रः)
A silly brother in law of a Raja.

m. (-रः)
A bull.
f. (-री)
1 A river.
2 A zone, a girdle.
3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each.
4 A woman of an impure caste; it is also read शक्वर, q. v.

m. (-रः)
An ox.
n. (-रं)
A form of metre.
E.
शक्कर, and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Bearing or returning tax or toll.
2 Having rays, &c.
E.
स with, कर tax, &c.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Having form or shape.
E.
स with, आकार form.

m. (-रिः)
VIKRAMĀDITYA, the celebrated sovereign of Oujein.
E.
शक a Saca or Scythian, and अरि the foe.

m. (-रिः)
A bull; see the last.

f. (-री)
One of the dialects of dramatic Prākṛta, that spoken by the Sakāra.
E.
शकार, अण् and ङीष् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A bird in general.
2 A kind of bird, either the Indian vulture or the common kite, (Falco cheela); it is also applied to the Pondicherry eagle, (Falco ponticeriana.)
3 A sort of hymn or song, sung at festivals to solicit or secure lucky events.
n. (-नं)
Any lucky or auspicious object or omen.
E.
शक to be able, उन Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Of or relating to birds.
2 Ominous, portentous.
E.
शाकुन, and अण् aff.

f. (-ज्ञा)
A small house lizard.
E.
शकुन a bird, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-निः)
1 A bird.
2 The maternal uncle of the Kaurava princes, and counsellor of DURYODHANA.
3 One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas.
4 The Indian kite or eagle, (Falco cheela.)
f. (-नी)
A hen sparrow.
E.
शक to be able, उनि Uṇādi aff.

f. (-पा)
A trough or little well for watering birds.
E.
शकुनि a bird, प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
A name of GARUḌA.
E.
शकुनि a bird, and ईश्वर chief.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A bird.
2 A kind of bird, the Indian vulture.
3 Another sort of bird, described as of aquatic habits, perhaps a kind of maritime or fishing falcon.
4 A sort of insect.
5 The blue jay.
E.
शक to be able, उन्त Uṇādi aff.; also शकुन, &c.

f. (-ला)
The daughter of MENAKĀ, the courtezan of Svarga, by the sage VIŚVĀMITRA, brought up by KAṆVA the hermit, and afterwards married to DUṢYANTA, by whom she became the mother of BHARATA, the sovereign of all India.
E.
शकुन्त a bird, ला to get, aff. क, and टाप्, being born in a solitary forest, and protected by the birds till found by KAṆVA.

m. (-जः)
BHARATA, the sovereign of India.
E.
शकुन्तला as above, and आत्मज the son.

m. (-न्तिः)
1 A bird in general.
2 A kind of bird: see शकुन्त, &c.
E.
शक to be able, Uṇādi aff. उन्ति.

f. (-का)
A locust, a cricket.
E.
शकुन्त a bird, कन् aff. of comparison.

m. (-लः)
A fish.
E.
शक to be able, aff. उलच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having a family, belonging to one, &c.
m. (-लः)
A sort of fish; also शकुल.
E.
स with, कुल a family.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of fish, the gilt-head.

m. (-कः)
Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon), with white blossoms.
E.
शकुल a fish, अक्षि the eye, अच् substituted for the final vowel; the blossoms being compared to the eye of a fish.

f. (-नी)
1 A medicinal plant, commonly Kaṭuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
2 A creeping plant, (Jussieua repens.)
3 A drug, commonly Kāyaphal.
4 An earth worm.
E.
शकुल a fish, अद to eat, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of gilt-head, (Sparus emarginatus.)
E.
शकुल a fish, and अर्भक a young one.

n. (-कृत्)
Fæces, excrement.
E.
शक to be able, (to expel,) Uṇādi aff. ऋतन्.

m. (-कृत्)
Fæces, ordure: more usually, शकृत्.
ind.
1 Once.
2 With, together with.
3 Always.
E.
सकृत् substituted for एक one.

mf. (-रिः-री)
A calf.
E.
शकृत् ordure, कृ to make, इन् aff. in this sense.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Making ordure or fæces.
E.
शकृत् ordure, and कार who or what makes.

n. (-रं)
The anus.
E.
शकृत् fæces, and द्वार passage.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Able, capable, strong, powerful.
2 Speaking civilly, able to please by the manner of speaking.
3 Diligent, attentive, intent.
E.
शक to be able, aff. क्त.

m. (-क्तः)
A worshipper of the female principle.
E.
शक्ति the divine energy in its feminine personification, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Attached, joined, in contact with.
2 Diligent, attentive, intent.
3 Devoted or addicted to.
E.
षञ्ज to embrace or adhere to, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Ability, power.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्तत्वं.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Power, regal power as resulting from majesty, perseverance, and counsel.
2 Power, strength, prowess.
3 An iron spear or dart.
4 The energy or active power of a deity, personified as his wife, as GAURI of ŚIVA, LAKṢMĪ of VIṢṆU, &c.
5 The female organ as the counterpart of the phallic personification of ŚIVA, and worshipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindus, thence termed Śāktas.
6 Allaying or appeasing opposition.
7 Force or signification of words.
E.
शक to be able, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Contact, union, junction, cohesion.
2 Devotion or addiction to.
E.
षञ्ज to embrace or adhere to, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-हः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 KĀRTTIKEYA.
3 A spearman, a lancer.
E.
शक्ति a spear, and ग्रह who holds.

ind.
According to power or ability.
E.
शक्ति, and तसि aff.

n. (-यं)
The three ingredients of regal power; or king, minister, and vigour.
E.
शक्ति, and चय triad.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 A spearman, a lancer.
E.
शक्ति a spear, and धर the holder.

m. (-र्णः)
A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
शक्ति strength, (giving it,) and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-णिः)
1 KĀRTTIKEYA, the Hindu MARS.
2 A spearman.
E.
शक्ति a spear, and पाणि the hand.

m. (-भृत्)
1 KĀRTTIKEYA, see the last.
2 A soldier armed with a spear.
E.
शक्ति a spear, and भृत् who holds.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Powerful, mighty.
E.
शक्ति, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-ल्यं)
Inability, deficiency of power or strength.
E.
शक्ति, and वैकल्य imperfection.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Powerless, impotent.
E.
शक्ति, and हीन abandoned.

m. (-कः)
A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with an iron lance.
E.
शक्ति a spear, हेति a weapon, and कन् added.

mn. (-क्तुः-क्तु) according to some authorities only m. plu. (शक्तवः)
The powder or flour of barley and other grain, first fried and then ground.
E.
शच to go, &c. तुन् aff.; also read सक्तु.

m. (-क्तः)
Rice or corn fried and then ground.
E.
षच to moisten, Uṇādi aff. तुन्; also read शक्तु.

f. (-ला)
The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)
E.
शक्त farina, and फल fruit; also शक्तुफली, and सक्तुफला.

f. (-ला)
The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)
E.
सक्तु barley meal, and फल fruit; of a similar white colour; also सक्तुफली.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Being according to, or having reference to, ability, power, &c.
E.
शक्ति, and अपेक्षा regard to.

mfn. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं)
Speaking civilly or pleasingly: see the next.

mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु)
Speaking civilly or kindly.
E.
शक to be able, (to please by speaking,) aff. क्नु; also with the vowel rejected शक्न, and with क्ल aff. शक्ल.

m. (-क्मा)
Power, strength.
E.
शक to be able, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
Possible, practicable, to be effected or done.
E.
शक to be able, aff. यत्.

m. (-क्यः)
1 BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion.
2 The name of a tribe.
E.
शक to be able, ण्यत् aff.

f. (-ता)
Possibility.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्यत्वं.

m. (-रः)
A possible remedy or counteragent.
E.
शक्य, and प्रतीकार remedy.

m. (-क्रः)
INDRA, the chief of the inferior gods, and ruler of Svarga or paradise.
2 A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
शक to possess power, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

m. (-लः)
Mount Meru.
E.
शक्र INDRA, क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and अचल a mountain.

m. (-पः)
An insect of a red colour, (Coccinella or ladybird of various species.)
E.
शक्र INDRA, गो light, &c. and पा to preserve, aff. क.

m. (-जः)
A crow.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and ज born.

m. (-तः)
A crow.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and जात born.

m. (-जित्)
The son of RĀVAṆA.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and जित् victor.

n. (-नुः)
The bow of INDRA, the rain-bow.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and धनुस् the bow.

n. (-जं)
A pole or flag set up in honour of INDRA.
E.
शक्र, and ध्वज a flag.

m. (-नः)
ARJUNA.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and नन्दन son.

m. (-पः)
A sort of pine, (P. devadaru, Rox.)
E.
शक्र INDRA, and पादप a tree.

f. (-ष्पी)
A sort of potherb; also Viśalyā.
E.
शक्र the Pentaptera arjuna, and पुष्प a flower; having similar flowers.

n. (-नं)
Sky, heaven.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and भवन abode; being the god of the firmament: it also occurs शक्रभुवन, from भुवन a world.

m. (-भिद्)
The son of RĀVAṆA.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and भिद् defeater.

f. (-वा)
Colocynth, (Cucumis coloquintida.)

m. (-र्द्ध्वा)
An ant hill, a hillock.
E.
शक्र INDRA, मूर्द्ध्वन् the head.

m. (-नः)
A cloud.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and वाहन vehicle.

n. (-नं)
The rain-bow.
E.
शक्र INDRA, शरासन a bow.

f. (-ला)
A place prepared for sacrifices to be offered in.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and शाला a hall.

n. (-रः)
An ant hill
E.
शक्र. INDRA, and शिरस् the head.

m. (-थिः)
The charioteer of INDRA.
E.
शक्र, and सारथि a coachman.

m. (-तः)
1 The monkey king BALI.
2 ARJUNA.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and सुत the son.

f. (-धा)
The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, or gum olibanum.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and सुधा ambrosia.

f. (-ष्टा)
Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
E.
शक्र INDRA, सृष्ट created; springing originally, it is said, from the ground on which INDRA spilt a drop of nectar as he was drinking.

m. (-ख्यः)
An owl.

f. (-णी)
SACĪ, the wife of INDRA.
E.
शक्र INDRA, ङीष् aff. and आनुक् inserted.

m. (-नः)
A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
E.
शक्र INDRA, अशन food: created by him; springing from the drops of Amṛta, which fell on the ground from the bodies of the monkies slain in the war with RĀVAṆA, and who were restored to life by INDRA by a shower of Amṛta, or the liquor of immortality.

m. (-वः)
A festival in honour of INDRA on the twelfth of the month Bhādra.
E.
शक्र INDRA, and उत्सव a festival.

mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं)
Speaking civilly or kindly.
E.
शक to be able, (to delight simply by speaking,) and क्ल Uṇādi affix; also शक्न and शक्नु.

m. (-क्वा)
An elephant.
E.
शक to be powerful, and वनिप् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A bull, an ox.
f. (-री)
1 A finger.
2 A river.
3 A zone, a girdle.
4 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each, and comprising many varieties according to the different feet of which the lines are composed.
E.
शक to be able or strong, क्वरप् aff., or वनिप् aff. with र augment, and the final rejected: the feminine form is also derived from शक्वन् with ङीप् affix, and र augment, and the word is also read शक्कर and शक्करी.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Belonging or relating to a cart.
m. (-नः)
A cart-load as a measure of weight or value.
E.
शकट a cart, ख aff.

m. (-रुः)
A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.)
E.
शाक a potherb, and तरु a tree.

m. (-णः)
A handful or similar quantity, as a measure of potherbs.
E.
शाक, and पण price.

m. (-यः)
A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi; also वालेयशाक.

f. (-री)
1 DURGĀ.
2 A city, supposed to be the modern Sāmbher.
E.
शाक a potherb, भृ to nourish, aff. खश्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

n. (-यं)
A fossile salt brought from a lake in the vicinity of Sāmbher, a town in Ajmere.
E.
शाकम्भरी the city, and छ aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Having a piece or part.
E.
शकल a part, ठञ् aff.

m. (-ल्वः)
The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
शाक a potherb, विल्व the Bel fruit; also with कन् added शाकविल्वक.

m. (-रः)
A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
शाक a potherb, and वीर eminent.

m. (-क्षः)
The Teak tree.
E.
शाक the same, and वृक्ष a tree.

n. (-टं)
A field of vegetables, a kitchen garden.
E.
शाक a potherb, and शाकट aff. in this sense.

n. (-नं)
A field cultivated for esculent plants, a field of vegetables, a kitchen garden.
E.
शाक a vegetable, and शाकिन aff. in this sense.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
शाक a potherb, and श्रेष्ठ best.

m. (-ख्यः)
The Teak tree.
E.
शाक the same, and आख्या appellation.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Pepper.
E.
शाक a potherb, and अङ्ग a part.

f. (-नी)
A female divinity of an inferior character, attendant especially on ŚIVA and DURGĀ.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Repentant, regretting.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or relating to birds, omens, &c.
m. (-कः)
A fowler, a bird-catcher.
n. (-कं)
Interpretation of omens, dreams, &c.
E.
शकुन a bird, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-मः)
BHARATA, the sovereign of India.
E.
शकुन्तला the nymph, and ढक् aff.; being the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ and DUṢYANTA.

m. (-कः)
A fisherman.
E.
शकुल a fish, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Speared, spearing, relating to or done with a spear.
m. (-कः)
A spearman, a lancer.
E.
शक्ति a spear, aff. ईकक्.

m. (-क्त्यः)
A worshipper of the female principle or Śakti.
E.
शक्ति the personified energy of a divinity, and यञ् aff.

m. (-निः)
A name of BUDDHA, the real or supposed founder of the Bauddha religion.
E.
शाक्य said to be the name of a family or tribe, originating with one of the race of Ikṣvāku, condemned to take up his abode in a forest of Sāka trees, and मुनि a saint.

m. (-हः)
A name of BUDDHA.
E.
शाक्य the name of his tribe, and सिंह chief.

n. (-न्नं)
Impure food.
E.
सकट, and अन्न boiled rice.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Thorny, prickly.
2 Troublesome, perilous.
m. (-कः)
